en: This is a black and white postcard featuring a fountain with sculpted children and a decorative water basin, surrounded by a landscaped garden with banana trees. The image is taken in a public park, with the sea visible in the background. The text on the front is in Bulgarian and German, and the back is filled with handwritten Cyrillic text, stamps, and a postmark from Varna. The message is addressed to Sofia.
